scoring_justification: Checker recomputes critical temperature from Binder cumulant intersection, checks energy cumulant low-T limit, and counts histogram peaks, all from the raw data in results.json. The paper-reported T_N values are used to set target ranges.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target T_N ranges for r=0.2 and r=0.7 derived from paper's phase diagram (Fig. 5 and Fig. 6) and the trend T_N(r=0.7) > T_N(r=0.2)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Estimates from the Binder cumulant intersection figures and phase diagram
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are consistent with the paper's reported phase diagram (Fig. 9) typical T_N values for those r, approximate to within tolerance. They correspond to the expected output of a correct Monte Carlo reproduction.

schema.units: T_N: unitless (k_B T / |J|); U and V: dimensionless; histogram for L=150 at T_N

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the critical temperature, Binder cumulant curves, and energy histogram for two coupling ratios. The checker will recompute T_N from U_data intersection, verify V_L(T) trend, and count histogram peaks.

output_contract.notes: The task requires reproducing the simulation and analysis for r=0.2 and r=0.7 only. The full phase diagram over all r is not required. The simulation must produce statistically converged data; the exact number of MC steps is not mandated. All temperatures and cumulants use reduced units k_B T / |J|.
